verdict.rationale: replica-skill writes Playwright test specs and ships the app to production after a preflight. However, no evidence documents a sandbox or staging environment, test-mode credentials, or isolation of tests from production data. The note that its helper Python scripts do not touch the network is an adjacent property of local tooling, not a sandbox environment for testing the built app.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
